I'll start by reading the execution file and understanding the scope.
Now I have the full picture. Let me create the badge component and its styles.
Now wire the derived readiness map in the panel and pass it to the group.
Task CLOSE-3 is complete. All required validation commands pass.

## Files created or changed

**Created**
- `src/features/case/TopicStatusBadge.tsx` — derived topic-status chip with text, distinct icon silhouette, tone, and accessible name (`Topic status: Solved, 2 linked notes`). Returns `null` for notes and sources.
- `src/features/case/TopicStatusBadge.css` — token-only styles for the Orphan/Developing/Solved tones, wrapping at phone widths, reduced-motion override.
- `tests/case/TopicStatusBadge.test.tsx` — 20 tests: all three states, 0/1/2+/7 notes, icon presence and distinctness, accessible label, Tab skip, notes/sources guard, no score wording, card-list live updates, real picker add/delete on topic detail, note/source detail exclusion, palette/contrast/reduced-motion CSS contract.

**Changed**
- `src/features/case/CardListPanel.tsx` — derives `deriveReadiness(cards, connections).topics` once per render into a card-id map; topic rows render `TopicStatusBadge`; notes/sources keep the string count and never receive a badge. Removed the old string-count topic status.
- `src/features/cards/CardDetailPage.tsx` — derives topic readiness for the current card from the in-memory `cards`/`connections` snapshot and renders the badge only for `type === 'topic'`.
- `tests/case/CardListPanel.test.tsx` — two topic-row assertions updated from `1 string attached` to the derived `Topic status: Developing, 1 linked note` badge. No behavior weakened; notes/sources counts remain asserted.

**Untouched:** `src/board/**` (Pixi sprite), domain selectors, repositories, and `docs/artifacts/`.

## Acceptance results

| Criterion | Result |
|---|---|
| Orphan/Developing/Solved render with text and icon at 0/1/2+ | Pass — badge states + 7-note case; each state has a distinct SVG and visible label |
| Badge updates after a connection is added or removed without reload | Pass — real keyboard picker flow on topic detail: Orphan → add association → Developing → delete → Orphan; card-list prop updates also verified without remount |
| Notes and sources never render a topic badge | Pass — component guard plus list/detail integration checks on both types |
| Accessible name includes status and linked-note count | Pass — `role="status"` with `aria-label="Topic status: …, N linked note(s)"`; keyboard Tab skips the non-interactive chip |
| No points, XP, score, or ranking copy | Pass — regex assertion over visible text and accessible names of all three states |

## Accessibility evidence

- Announcement: `role="status"` live region; label changes in place when a string is added/removed, so the new status is announced politely without moving focus.
- Keyboard: status chip is not focusable; a Tab harness proves it is skipped between real controls. Picker add/delete path exercised with `user-event` keyboard only.
- Contrast: Orphan `8.76:1`, Developing `8.54:1`, Solved `6.01:1` (≥ 4.5:1). Colour is never the only signal — text plus distinct icon.
- No raw hex/rgb/hsl in the component or CSS (asserted); reduced-motion transition removal asserted.
- `aria-label` is duplicated by visible text, so sighted and screen-reader users get the same words.

## Validation run

- `npm test -- tests/case/TopicStatusBadge.test.tsx` — 20/20 pass.
- `npm run typecheck` — pass.
- Additional: full `npm test` 914/914 pass; `npm run lint` clean; `npm run build` succeeds; Prettier clean on changed files.

## Shared-file handoff

`CardListPanel.tsx` and `CardDetailPage.tsx` now require readiness to remain derived from repository/state data on every render. Do not cache `status`/`linkedNoteCount` on `CardRecord`, and keep the badge mounted only for topics. `tests/case/CardListPanel.test.tsx` now expects the badge label instead of the old topic string count.

## Limitations

Only jsdom component tests were exercised; no Playwright viewport matrix or real-browser visual check was run for this task (not part of the required validation). CSS is token-based, wraps at narrow widths, and adds no fixed widths, but the phone/tablet visual pass remains with responsive hardening.

handoff.summary: Implemented CLOSE-3: derived topic-status badge with text, icon, tone, and linked-note count on topic detail and the card list; notes and sources stay unbadged, statuses update in place after keyboard connection add/delete, and all required checks pass.
decisions: TopicStatusBadge accepts the readiness-derived status and count, never computes or stores them; call sites derive via deriveReadiness on each render.
The component itself returns null for notes and sources as a guard in addition to opt-in call-site rendering.
The badge uses a polite status role with an aria-label naming both status and count; it is non-interactive and skipped by Tab.
Replaced the old plain string-count topic line in the card list with the badge, preserving note/source string counts.
interfaces: linkedNoteCountLabel formatting: 0 linked notes / 1 linked note / N linked notes
CardListPanelProps.connections now feeds render-time readiness derivation
warnings: Only component tests were required; no Playwright journey was run for the badge task.
validationLimitations: Responsive visual behavior at 390x844/768x1024/1280x800 was not exercised in a real browser for this task; the CSS uses wrapping and tokens only, and the browser matrix remains with A11Y hardening.
